data: What is the value of the AUC-PR for the orange line when the number of training samples is approximately 10^3?

The orange line represents the Self-Supervised Pretraining & Supervised Finetuning method. The blue line represents the Supervised Training method. The top graph shows the AUC-PR values, while the bottom graph shows the AUC-ROC values. The x-axis represents the Number of Training Samples, and the y-axis represents the AUC-PR and AUC-ROC percentages.

To find the value of the AUC-PR for the orange line when the number of training samples is approximately 10^3:

1. Locate the orange line on the graph.
2. Find the point where the x-axis value is approximately 10^3.
3. Observe the corresponding y-axis value for the AUC-PR.

The orange line intersects the y-axis at approximately 85% when the number of training samples is around 10^3. Therefore, the value of the AUC-PR for the orange line when the number of training samples is approximately 10^3 is approximately 85%.
